sections.Profile:
The "Wipe Out" pinball machine, manufactured by Premier/Gottlieb in 1993, is themed around skiing and offers a dynamic and engaging gameplay experience. Designed by Ray Tanzer with artwork by David Moore, Constantino, and Jean Mitchell, this machine features a unique split-level playfield. Players can utilize a belt-driven Ski Lift to access the upper playfield and navigate the player-controlled tilting Winter Slalom for extra points.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1993
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Original Theme, Skiing, 1990s, Solid State
